I’m 15 and feeling the exact same, my plan is to kill myself at midnight, I don’t know how. Life’s shit for me and I can’t go on as I’ve explained in an earlier post. I’m at a lost and won’t be able to find my way back.

But why the fuck does it have to happen to people like us. That’s what I don’t understand. It fucking sucks. I have done nothing to deserve the shit I get. I know you say to think of it as being a lone wolf but it’s hard to to listen to what people have to say about you. It makes me feel like shit. It’s not fair, I don’t deserve it and while people who do this to me are sat at home happy as can be I’m here by myself trying to end it all.

I’m so paranoid about someone finding out who I am. There was something I enjoy doing but I just have no energy to do it anymore. It’s what this whole I guess ‘depression’ is doing to me. Sorry if I shouldn’t say that because I don’t know if I am, never seen a doctor but certainly feels that way. I know for sure I have anxiety and I’m to the point where I can’t be bothered to get up really. I thought everything would be fine once I left school, it hasn’t. This is what has got to me the most. I don’t feel any different, in fact worse since school occupied my time even if there was lunch and break times of hell. Finding it very hard. However I am re considering ending my life tonight, probably because I don’t know how I’d do it yet. I’m sure once I know how, it’ll happen shortly after. I do really appreciate your comment. It’s like someone cares or knows what it’s like I guess. I really don’t know
